title: AQFC 2026

sections.text: Our lab attended AQFC 2026, held in Pohang. Jeonggyu Huh and Dongwan Shin gave presentations titled “Recovering No-Trade Regions: Pontryagin-Guided Policy Projection for Transaction-Cost Control” and “Decision Focused Learning of Asset Betas for Sharpe-Optimal Portfolios,” respectively. 🤓
